priority: coffee arabica MG, coffee total MG, coffee conilon ES

development_data.loader: data/ingest/cohort_v8.load_development: explicit files only, rejects any harvest year > 2021, duplicated keys, cutoffs after the decision and unpublished lags
development_data.forbidden: 2022-2024 test tables, predictions and sealed labels (opened once for v7; context only, never used for features, selection or bias correction)

partitions.external_validation: walk-forward targets 2019, 2020, 2021; each fitted on harvests <= Y-2 (PAM publication gap)
partitions.internal_selection: inside each external fold: validate on the last 2 training years, fit on training years <= first validation year - 2 (one-year publication gap); every choice (baseline, feature set, learner, hyperparameters, shrinkage) is made here
partitions.spatial: existing hashed holdout; scores reported separately for municipalities used in training and held-out municipalities
partitions.grouping: all cutoffs of a harvest stay together; independent units = municipality x crop x harvest

soy_mgmt.metric_weighting: harvest-level MAE, mean per state, 50% MG / 50% MT

annual: fitted history (Ridge on trend and lags)
v7 regional MLP site config (soy MG+MT only)

feature_sets_annual.F3_full: weather + water balance + latitude, longitude, elevation

mlp.loss: smooth_l1 on the standardized residual (as v7)

candidates.shrinkage_note: prediction = base + shrinkage x learned correction; 0 is the base itself
registered_experiments: soy and maize2: national vs scope-only training pool
soy: learning curve by number of training harvest years and municipalities
maize2: irrigation infrastructure attribute (Censo Agro 2017 pivot share), only for targets decided after its publication (2019-10-25), i.e. folds 2020 and 2021
coffee: direct model vs correction of ref_cycle_mean
loss: MSE vs smooth_l1 for the selected soy MLP (one experiment, reported, not used for selection)

aggregation: cutoffs averaged within each harvest before averaging harvests; by state, year, cutoff and spatial scope
uncertainty: paired differences, bootstrap of municipalities (2000 draws, seed 42), stratified by state for MG+MT; year sensitivity reported; few years limit the interval

promotion_criteria.reference: the strongest simple reference on the external validation (lowest MAE among published mean and fitted history; coffee: also the four coffee references) - a deliberately hard bar
promotion_criteria.otherwise: experimental; the winning reference is documented
promotion_criteria.note: 5% is an engineering threshold chosen in this plan, not a scientific standard

independent_evaluation.eligibility_audit: no 2025 label was used in v3-v7 development or selection; the live job and one debugging print read PAM 2025 values as lag inputs for harvest 2027 (coffee, municipality 3170206) - recorded as minor exposure
independent_evaluation.procedure: after committing the frozen v8 choices: fetch PAM 2025 into a separate sealed folder; build 2025 features with the retrospective sources used in training; refit the frozen configuration on harvests <= 2023 (2022-2023 labels used for fitting only); score once against the same baselines
independent_evaluation.technical_failure_rule: a technical failure may be fixed and rerun with justification, never by changing choices after seeing results

limitations_declared_upfront: 2019-2021 were inspected in earlier rounds (v3-v7); the external validation is not pristine
2022-2024 cannot be an independent test anymore
municipal yield does not validate field yield or causal management effects
